Text: Well go on then! Can't have you sitting around here all day.
No, I will not just hand out spells to a fresh apprentice like you! Go find your own scrolls.
Goblins...goblins...Im sure they won't be too much of an issue
Ah! Well I see you survived! Good job on not dying too quick.
Welcome to my tower. I am your master and new mentor, Wizard.
What, expected some other fleshed out name or title? Its a demo, don't worry about specifics.
Anyways...
Downstairs will be the rooms available to you, my last apprentice probably left a few things before ...the incident...
There is a study to perfect your skills and study your magic, and a couple chests from the one before.
I can translate any scrolls you find until you learn how yourself. The portal will take you to any locations I may permit.
Don't take too long, I have place nearby needing clearing of goblins!
Damn things got a little too comfortable after the last apprentice I sent wasn't worth the sandals they were wearing!
I hear one of them has a knack for magic, might want to be careful around that one.
Welcome back! I see you aren't dead!
Well, I can say you are already doing better than most...provided you haven't contracted some horrific plague that will leave a mess for me to clean.
Ive seen that before. The stains.....
Anyways...
Your reward is a chamber to study in.
And more work. Only another goblin caster causing problems. Its alright, you have a better handle of what youre doing now, right?
Have fun, dont die. Really not wanting to have to get a fifth apprentice this month.
Back again! Im almost impressed.
Well, thats all I have for you for now. Feel free to check those sites again for more goblins showing up. Tends to happen.
Ill let you know when I have more work!
